title_ar: بيان حول ما يجري في غزة
title_en: A Statement on What Is Happening in Gaza
body_ar:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم صلى الله على نبيه الكريم الحمد لله .. أَمَّا بعدُ فهذا بيان عامٌ إلى كلِّ من يقف عليه من المسلمين في أنحاء العالم.

السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته ، ثم إِنه لا يخفى عليكم ما يتعرض له إِخوانكم في غزة منذ مدة طويلة من الحصار والتجويع والإذلال، وَما يتعرضون له اليوم من إبادةٍ جماعيَّةٍ وقصفٍ متواصلٍ وتحطيم للمنازل وَالمدارس والمستشفياتِ والمتاجر وإحراق للمصالح والمزارع حتى أصبح الخارج من بيته لا يُؤمل الرجوع إليه، والباقي في بيته لا يؤمل الخروج منه مع الترويع والحرب النفسية والإعلامية التي تحمِّلهم مسؤولية كل هذا الذي له يتعرضون من العدوان الآثم الغاشم.

ولا عقل ولا شرع ولا مروءة يحلُّ السكوت على هذا، فهل من حقوق الإِنسان أن يباد كما تباد الحشرات، فلذلك أذكركم جميعا بحقوقهم عليكم وَأنه لا يحلُّ لكم خِذلانهم وإِسلامهم، وقد قال الله تعالى: (وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَاجْعَل لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجْعَل لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ نَصِيرًا.) وقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: (المسلم أخو المسلم لا يظلمه ولا يحقره ولا يخذله.)

فيا حُكامَ المسلمين تذكروا خروجكم من القصور إلى القبور ووقوفكم في عرصاتِ القيَامةِ وعرضكم على الجبَّار وخصام هؤلاء المساكين لكم عنده في ما لهم من الحقوق عليكم في وقتٍ ليس لكم فيه مُدافع ولا مناصر (هَذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ.) فأروا الله من أنفسكم خيراً الآن وأروا شعوبكم أنكم أهل للقيادة بقرار شجاعٍ واقطعوا العلاقات الظاهرة والباطنة مع الصهاينة وافتحوا المعابر وَالحدود وعالجوا الجرحى وأنفقوا على اليتامى والأيامى من مال الله الذي جعل تحت أيديكم قبل أن يعزلكم عنه.

ويا أيمة المسلمين وعلماءهم وفرسان منابرهم ومحابرهم أعلنوا الحق ولا تكتموه فهو أمَانة الله لديكم وقنتوا بإِنقاذ إِخوانكم أربعين يومًا وبطلب النجاة لقياداتهم وعلمائهم كما قنت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم شهرًا أو أربعين يومًا بالدعاء على المشركين والدعاء بنجاة المستضعفِين من المسلمين وكان يسمي الوليد ابن الوليد وسلمة بن هشامٍ وعياش بن أبي ربيعة.

ويا رجال الإِعلام وفرسان الأقلام هذا وقتكم ولا عطر بعد عروس، فقولوا تسمعِ الشعوب واكتبوا فإِن الأقلام تفعل ما لا تفعل السهام.

ويا رجال المال والأعمال هذه فرصتكم لتكفروا سيئاتكم فقد قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حين أنفق عثمان: (لا يضرُّ عثمان ما فعل بعد اليوم.) وإن لهم ـ والله ـ حقا في أموالكم وما جعلكم الله مستخلفين فيه، فتذكروا يوم خروجكم منه لا يصحبكم منه إلا مَا قدمتم، وإنهم الآن أولى بالزكاة الواجبة لأنهم يجمعون أكثر مصارفها الثمانية.

ويا أيها الطلاب ويا حياة الشعوب النابضة قوموا بما ينتظر منكم من المآزرة والمناصرة بكل الوسائل المشروعةِ بانضباطٍ ونشاطٍ .

ويا نساء المسلمين تذكرن أنكن على أثر عائشة وفاطمة وأُمِّ سليم رضي الله عنهن وتذكرن تضحيتهن وما قدمن يوم أُحدٍ ، وما قدمت نسيبة رضي الله عنها وموعدكن مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الحوض المورود ،

ويا بقية الشعوب المسلمة إنكم فئة هؤلاء القوم فلا تبخلوا على أنفسكم بالصدقة عليهم والصدقة عنهم لنجاتهم والدعاءِ والمشاركة في كلِّ نشاطٍ فيه نصرة لهم وتعريف بقضيتهم.

وليعلم الجميع أن النصر آتٍ لامحالة (أَلَا إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ.) وَأن الأمر إِنما هو ابتلاء من الله تعالى للمسلمين فإن قاموا بالحق نجحُوا في الإمتحان ونصروا وإلا فإِن البلاء سيحور عليهم كما قال الله تعالى: (ذَلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لِيَبْلُوَ بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَنْ يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آَمَنُوا إِنْ تَنْصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَتَعْسًا لَهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ.)

ولْيعلم الجميع كذالك أنما قدموا لن يضيع عند الله فالله لا يضيع أجر من أحسن عملا. وأن ما ينفقونه مخلوف في الدنيا قبل الآخرةِ كما قال تعالى: (وَمَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ مِنْ نَفَقَةٍ أَوْ نَذَرْتُمْ مِنْ نَذْرٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُهُ.) وقال تعلى: (وَمَا تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلِأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَمَا تُنْفِقُونَ إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ وَمَا تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ.) وقال تعالى: (وَمَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ.)

أسأل الله تعالى أن يرفع هذا البلاء وأن ينتصر لإِخواننا المظلومين وأن ينصرهم نصرًا مبينا عاجلا، وأن يرحم الشهداء ويتقبلهم وأن يشفيَ الجرحى وأن يحفظ المجاهدين وقادتهم أجمعين بما يحفظ به عباده الصالحين وأن يوفق قادة المسلمين لنصرتهم والقيام بحقهم. وأن يرد كيد المعتدين في نحورهم وأن يسلِّط عليهم البأساءَ والضرَّاءَ وأن ينزل بهم القوارعَ وَأن يُفيِّلَ رأيهم وأن يخيِّبَ أملهم وأن يجعل تدبيرهم تدميرهم وأن يدخلهم في ردغة الخبال وأن يسُلَّ عليهم سيفَ الذل والوَبَالِ. (عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَكُفَّ بَأْسَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ بَأْسًا وَأَشَدُّ تَنْكِيلًا.)

كتبه محمد الحسن ابن الدَّدَوْ الشنقيطي. بتاريخ/30/12/1429 هـ الموافق/ 28/12/ 2008 م
body_en:
In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate. May God bless His noble Prophet. Praise belongs to God.. To proceed: this is a general statement to every Muslim throughout the world into whose hands it comes.

Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God and His blessings. It is not hidden from you what your brothers in Gaza have been subjected to for a long time — siege, starvation and humiliation — nor what they are being subjected to today: genocide, unceasing bombardment, the destruction of homes, schools, hospitals and shops, and the burning of businesses and farms, until the one who leaves his house has no hope of returning to it, and the one who stays in his house has no hope of leaving it; together with the terrorising, and the psychological and media war that lays upon them the responsibility for all this sinful, brutal aggression to which they are being subjected.

Neither reason, nor the revealed law, nor common decency allows silence over this. Is it among the rights of a human being that he should be exterminated as insects are exterminated? For that reason I remind you all of the rights they hold over you, and that it is not lawful for you to abandon them and give them up. God, exalted, has said: {And what is the matter with you, that you do not fight in the way of God, and for the oppressed among the men, the women and the children, who say: our Lord, bring us out of this town whose people are wrongdoers, and appoint for us from Yourself a protector, and appoint for us from Yourself a helper} (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:75). And the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: 'The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim: he does not wrong him, nor despise him, nor abandon him.'

O rulers of the Muslims: remember your going out from the palaces to the graves; your standing in the open plains of the Resurrection; your being presented before the Compeller; and the suit these wretched people will bring against you before Him over the rights they hold over you — at a time when you will have no defender and no supporter. {This is a Day when they will not speak, nor will they be permitted to make excuses} (Sūrat al-Mursalāt 77:35–36). So show God something good from yourselves now, and show your peoples that you are fit to lead, by a courageous decision: cut off relations, open and secret, with the Zionists; open the crossings and the borders; treat the wounded; and spend on the orphans and the widowed out of the wealth of God which He has placed under your hands, before He removes you from it.

O imams of the Muslims and their scholars, and horsemen of their pulpits and their inkwells: proclaim the truth and do not conceal it, for it is God's trust in your keeping. Make the supplication of qunūt for the rescue of your brothers for forty days, and for the deliverance of their leaders and their scholars, just as the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, made qunūt for a month — or for forty days — with supplication against the polytheists and supplication for the deliverance of the oppressed among the Muslims, and he used to name al-Walid ibn al-Walid, Salamah ibn Hisham and Ayyash ibn Abi Rabiah.

O men of the media and horsemen of the pen: this is your hour, and there is no perfume after the bride. So speak, and the peoples will hear; and write, for pens do what arrows do not.

O men of wealth and business: this is your opportunity to have your evil deeds wiped away. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said when Uthman spent: 'Nothing Uthman does after today will harm him.' And they have — by God — a right in your wealth and in what God has made you stewards over. So remember the day of your departure from it, when nothing of it will go with you but what you have sent on ahead. They are now the most deserving of the obligatory zakat, because they bring together most of its eight categories of entitlement.

O students, O pulsing life of the peoples: undertake what is expected of you, of backing and support, by every lawful means, with discipline and energy.

O women of the Muslims: remember that you are following in the track of Aishah, Fatimah and Umm Sulaym, may God be pleased with them; remember their sacrifice and what they gave on the day of Uhud, and what Nusaybah, may God be pleased with her, gave; and your appointed meeting with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, is at the Basin to which people come.

O remaining Muslim peoples: you are the company to which these people belong, so do not be miserly toward yourselves in giving charity to them, and charity on their behalf for their deliverance, and in supplication, and in taking part in every activity in which there is support for them and a making known of their cause.

And let everyone know that victory is coming without fail: {Truly, the help of God is near} (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:214); and that the matter is only a trial from God, exalted, for the Muslims — if they uphold the truth they succeed in the test and are granted victory, and if not, the affliction will come round upon them. As God, exalted, said: {That [is so]; and had God willed, He could have taken retribution from them, but [it is] so that He may test some of you by means of others. And those who fought in the way of God — never will He let their deeds go astray. He will guide them and set their condition right, and admit them to the Garden, which He has made known to them. O you who believe, if you help God, He will help you and make your feet firm. And those who disbelieve — ruin is for them, and He has made their deeds go astray} (Sūrat Muḥammad 47:4–8).

And let everyone likewise know that what they have given will not be lost with God, for God does not let go to waste the reward of one who does good work; and that what they spend is replaced in this world before the Hereafter, as He, exalted, said: {And whatever you spend of expenditure, or vow of a vow, God knows it} (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:270). And He, exalted, said: {And whatever good you spend is for yourselves, and you do not spend except seeking the face of God; and whatever good you spend will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged} (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:272). And He, exalted, said: {And whatever thing you spend, He will replace it, and He is the best of providers} (Sūrat Sabaʾ 34:39).

I ask God, exalted, to lift this affliction; to take retribution for our wronged brothers; to grant them a clear and speedy victory; to have mercy on the martyrs and accept them; to heal the wounded; to protect the fighters and all their leaders with that by which He protects His righteous servants; and to grant the leaders of the Muslims success in supporting them and fulfilling their right. And [I ask Him] to turn the scheming of the aggressors back into their own throats; to set upon them adversity and hardship; to send down upon them calamities; to bring their counsel to nothing; to disappoint their hope; to make their planning their own destruction; to cast them into the mire of ruin; and to draw against them the sword of abasement and doom. {It may be that God will restrain the might of those who disbelieve; and God is stronger in might and stronger in exemplary punishment} (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:84).

Written by Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew al-Shinqiti. Dated 30/12/1429 AH, corresponding to 28/12/2008 CE.

hold from publication pending the Sheikh's office
publish as an ordinary item in the creed series
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW REQUIRED (style guide §12). This is not a fatwa but a signed public political statement, written 28 December 2008 during the assault on Gaza of that winter, and later posted to the site in December 2010. It calls on Muslim rulers to sever open and secret relations with 'the Zionists', calls on scholars, media, businessmen, students and women to act, directs obligatory zakat to Gaza, and closes with a formal imprecation against the aggressors. It has been translated exactly as written — nothing softened, nothing sharpened, nothing added. Two things make display decisions urgent: it will read as a statement about the present unless its 2008 date is unmistakable on the page, and it is the kind of text whose English circulation carries legal exposure in several jurisdictions. The decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.context: وَما يتعرضون له اليوم من إبادةٍ جماعيَّةٍ وقصفٍ متواصلٍ
flags.note: الإبادة الجماعية is the standard Arabic term for genocide — it is the phrase used in Arabic for the Genocide Convention — so 'genocide' is the faithful rendering and the alternatives would soften it, which style guide §6 forbids. It is flagged nonetheless because the word carries specific legal weight in English, and because the Sheikh's next sentence ('exterminated as insects are exterminated') leans on the same root. The Sheikh's office should confirm the rendering before publication rather than a translator settling it.

flags.context: ويا رجال الإِعلام وفرسان الأقلام هذا وقتكم ولا عطر بعد عروس
options: there is no perfume after the bride
there is no occasion for this after today
flags.note: A classical Arabic proverb meaning that the moment has come and will not come again. The literal image has been kept because it is characteristic of the register of the whole statement; a reader unfamiliar with it may need a note on the page.

options: render as قاتلوا, 'those who fought', as the source has it
render as قُتلوا, 'those who were killed', the Hafs reading
flags.note: The source gives قاتلوا ('fought'); the Hafs transmission that most printed copies follow reads قُتلوا ('were killed'). Both are canonical readings of this verse, so this is a variant rather than an error, and the source's reading has been followed. Recorded here because in this particular statement the difference — those who fought, or those who were killed — is not neutral.

translator_notes: Qur'anic and hadith renderings in this file are interpretive translations of meaning, offered to carry the Sheikh's argument in English. They are not a substitute for the Arabic.

DATE: the statement carries its own date at the foot — 30/12/1429 AH, 28 December 2008 — while the site published it on 16 December 2010, which is the date in the 'date' field. The 2008 date is part of the text and must remain visible wherever this is displayed.
This item is a signed public statement (bayān), not a fatwa; it is typed 'article' for that reason.
The Sheikh gives his Qur'anic quotations in ordinary round brackets and without references. The English uses the house braces and supplies the references; the Arabic has not been altered.
No grading is given for either hadith quoted ('The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim' and 'Nothing Uthman does after today will harm him'), and none has been supplied.

Source spellings preserved verbatim in body_ar: أيمة for أئمة, كذالك for كذلك, أنما قدموا for أن ما قدموا, تعلى for تعالى, لامحالة written without a space, and الإمتحان with a connecting hamza. The Arabic of this item is partly vowelled in the source; the vowelling has been preserved as it stands, including where it is inconsistent.
